requirement_summary: As a citizen I want to register with my name and username So that I can access the Participium system and submit reports.
prompt: Execute registration for a new citizen user. Provide valid name, username, and email. Verify account creation success and return of temporary verification token or status indicating pending verification.
cleanup_strategy: Delete created resources or restore their previous state.
rationale: Core onboarding flow; validates user creation without authentication.

requirement_summary: As a citizen I want to confirm my registration with a code So that my account becomes valid and I can start using the system.
prompt: Submit verification code received during registration. Ensure token matches the one issued in PT01 setup. Verify account status transitions to 'active' or equivalent.
setup_needed: Execute PT01 (register) first to obtain verification token
cleanup_strategy: Verify account is active; no resource deletion required.
rationale: Critical state transition from pending to active user.

requirement_summary: As a system administrator I want to set up municipality users
prompt: Create a new municipality user account via admin endpoint. Provide valid username, email, and role assignment data. Verify successful creation and return of user ID.
setup_needed: Ensure admin authentication token is present
cleanup_strategy: Delete created user account if test fails or cleanup flag is set.
rationale: Validates admin capability to provision internal staff.

requirement_summary: As a system administrator I want to assign roles to municipality users
prompt: Assign a specific role (e.g., 'technical_office') to an existing municipality user. Verify role assignment succeeds and user permissions update accordingly.
setup_needed: Create a municipality user via PT02 or equivalent
cleanup_strategy: Revoke role assignment or delete user if test fails.
rationale: Validates role management functionality for staff.

requirement_summary: As a technical office staff member I want to assign reports to external maintainers So that specialized maintainers can handle and update the intervention.
prompt: Assign an existing report (from PT05) to an external maintainer. Provide valid maintainer ID and assignment details. Verify assignment succeeds and report metadata updates.
setup_needed: Authenticate as technical office staff member.
Create a report via PT05 to have a valid reportId
cleanup_strategy: Revoke assignment or delete report if test fails.
rationale: Validates cross-role collaboration and external maintainer assignment.

requirement_summary: As an external maintainer I want to update the status of a report assigned to me So that I can updated citizens about the intervention.
prompt: Update the status of a previously assigned report (from PT24) to 'in_progress' or 'completed'. Verify status change is persisted and visible to authorized users.
setup_needed: Assign report via PT24 to establish valid reportId
cleanup_strategy: Revert status change or delete report if test fails.
rationale: Validates external maintainer workflow and status updates.

requirement_summary: As a citizen I want to reply to messages from municipal operators in the platform So that I can communicate directly about my report.
prompt: Send a reply message within an existing chat thread (chatId derived from report). Ensure authenticated citizen session. Verify message is appended to thread and visible to operators.
setup_needed: Create a report via PT05 to establish chat context
cleanup_strategy: Delete sent message or archive chat if test fails.
rationale: Validates citizen communication channel within the platform.

requirement_summary: As a citizen/unregistered user I want to browse a summary table of reports with filters So that I can easily explore and analyze existing reports.
prompt: Retrieve paginated list of public reports. Apply optional filters (e.g., status, category). Verify response includes report summaries and filter logic works correctly for unauthenticated users.
rationale: Validates public-facing report discovery and filtering.

requirement_summary: As a citizen I want to provide details for my report So that the the problem is classified correctly.
prompt: Submit a new report with invalid category value (e.g., 'unknown_category'). Verify system rejects submission with appropriate error message and does not create resource.
setup_needed: Execute PT01 and PT27 to create active citizen account
cleanup_strategy: Verify no resource was created; delete it if unexpectedly present.
rationale: Validates input validation for report classification.

requirement_summary: As a technical office staff member I want to update report statuses So that citizens are informed of the problem resolution process.
prompt: Retrieve list of reports assigned to technical office staff. Verify response includes status updates from external maintainers (from PT25) and filtering by assignment role works correctly.
setup_needed: Authenticate as technical office staff member.
Assign report via PT24 and update status via PT25
rationale: Validates role-based data visibility and status propagation.
